scope: Narrow read of corrected projection, phase summary, member-name projection, output budgeting and known large-report processing. No artifact download, Python execution or native qualification by this reviewer.

resolved_in_source.evidence: phase modes, optional actual booleans and bounded integer values are checked; unknown confirmation flags remain explicit. Unknown fields/entire values, strings and member paths are hashed or omitted; public literal strings and error codes use closed sets.

The complete per-artifact derived payload and both printable projection lines are serialized and checked before writes. write_outputs also charges a cumulative 8 MiB derived budget, including the final SUMMARY; projection stdout retains its separate 2 MiB budget.

other_observations: Large JSON processing is restricted to six explicitly named original report paths at 128 MiB each; each is parsed/projected/dropped before the next. The small-JSON retained budget stays 64 MiB and the total returned decoded-byte cap stays 512 MiB.
A 4 GiB RLIMIT_AS cap is set on the actual reader path; this is an address-space cap, not an RSS estimate or an independently measured memory result.
Unknown labels are hashed before output and the aggregate visits only the closed public field set. Metrics outside the projection may be omitted; this does not prove a complete performance summary.
Original source-receipt fields remain checked against fixed commit/tree metadata. This review does not independently replay all original tracked source bytes.
qualification_boundary: Source changes address the two static findings. Actual followup hosted self-tests and complete artifact readback remain separate evidence.
